findings.finding: The first pass coerced arbitrary objects with str(), which could embed identity-dependent representations.
findings.resolution: Require nonempty trimmed strings before sorting or serialization.

findings.finding: The first pass accepted booleans and coercible numeric strings at selected binary64 boundaries.
findings.resolution: Require real non-boolean inputs, then finite-check normalized binary64 values.

findings.finding: Multiplication by a negative fixture coefficient emitted negative signed zero for a zero direction.
findings.resolution: Canonicalize fixture zero results to positive exact zero and inspect float.hex().

findings.finding: Custom public constructors omitted explicit None return annotations.
findings.resolution: Annotate every custom constructor and add an AST-wide public API gate.

findings.finding: The immutable semantic API allocates return values and must not become the optimized map-loop ABI.
findings.resolution: Document a separate future private caller-owned-buffer evaluate_into boundary; do not implement it in Step 3g1a.

findings.finding: Explicit SI field names initially accepted arbitrary unit-system identifiers.
findings.resolution: Require si_v1 for concrete public state types and add a canonical state/tangent compatibility gate.

findings.finding: The final broad Step 3g0 wildcard command reevaluated protected physical force/JVP functions, contrary to the Step 3g1a static source-only boundary.
findings.resolution: Not resolvable within this execution history; require a fresh preregistered source-only requalification and do not advance to Step 3g1b.
